items.title: Spotify users on iOS 27 can now ask Siri to play music without having to say ‘on Spotify’
items.content: Siri can now learn users' preferred music app, allowing Spotify listeners to request songs, podcasts, and playlists without specifying which app to use.

items.title: Apple refreshes its HomePod mini with a new chip and $149 price tag
items.content: The new $149 HomePod mini with Siri AI and a 'SoundGlow' visual feature will be available starting October 30.

items.title: Apple’s new smart home lineup includes a smart lock, thermostat, and video doorbells
items.content: The new devices work with HomeView, the company's new smart home hub which can be used to control accessories and interact with apps.

items.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
items.content: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.

items.title: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says AI models need an ‘emergency brake’
items.content: In a Saturday morning post, Microsoft's CEO wrote that it’s time “to step back and assess the trust architecture” of AI.

items.title: US bars Microsoft, Adobe, and major IT firms from green card program for skilled foreign workers
items.content: The other firms being suspended from the program include Capgemini, Cognizant, HCL, Infosys, Tata, and Wipro.

items.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
items.content: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

items.title: Mortgage Rates Hover at 7.4%, Highest Since 2023
items.content: The average 30-year, fixed-rate mortgage has steadily risen in recent weeks, compounding affordability challenges for many Americans.

items.title: Data Centers Become Targets in Wars in Ukraine, Russia and the Middle East
items.content: Military forces have sought to damage the computing hubs that power online services and artificial intelligence systems.

items.title: Homeownership Drifts Further Out of Reach as Mortgage Rates Rise
items.content: Mortgage rates have pushed above 7 percent and home prices remain elevated, hurting the prospects of would-be buyers.
